metric: Memory is interval-weighted average summed resident set size (RSS) in MiB for each observed main process and descendants. CPU is calculated from observed process CPU time; 100% equals one logical CPU fully occupied.
limitations: One completed shared-machine capture; not a query-latency or startup-speed benchmark.

Helpers outside the observed process trees, including macOS-managed WebKit helpers, are excluded. No extra helper PIDs were supplied. This undercounts Rowcraft total memory; these values are not complete app footprints.
External database servers and unrelated system services are excluded.
Results vary with workload, app version, hardware, power mode, and background activity.
RSS is not macOS physical footprint, JVM heap size, or unique memory. Shared pages may be counted more than once; compressed or swapped allocations are not fully represented.
source_report: Archived Rowcraft measurements from the completed 2026-10-18 connected-idle capture
